tagline: A shaded spot of their own beside your patio table, for dry afternoons outside.
lead: Your dog gets their own shaded lounging spot next to yours, under a slanted canopy, with a cushion included.
value: It looks like garden furniture rather than a pet bed, so it can sit beside your own outdoor seating. The cushion comes with it.
intro: Shore is a woven outdoor day bed for dogs, with a slanted canopy and an included cushion. It is made for dry, supervised afternoons on a patio or in a conservatory, not as all-weather shelter.
points: The woven finish sits well beside your own outdoor seating.
Their resting surface comes with the frame.
Woven sides let air move through while they lounge.
The canopy won't stop a dog overheating, so move it with the shade and keep water nearby.
best_for: Supervised lounging on a patio or in a conservatory in suitable weather. It is not all-weather shelter, so bring your dog indoors in extreme weather.
fit_note: Ask us for the internal floor, doorway height and supported load measurements before ordering. Your dog should be able to get in, stand, turn and lie down comfortably.
care: Wipe the frame with a damp cloth and mild soap. Follow the cushion's own care label, store it under cover, and let every part dry before use.
seo_title: Woven Canopy Dog Day Bed for the Patio | Snoozly
seo_description: A shaded patio spot for your dog: woven outdoor day bed with a slanted canopy and cushion included. Looks like garden furniture. For dry, supervised days.
